author: Daisy Rathi
text: That sounds so frustrating, especially with a baby. I’ve had similar issues before. I use BluCon Nightrider with my Libre and it’s helped me track my numbers more reliably and catch trends better. It’s made things much less stressful for me.

author: Rick Fritz
text: You can silence ALL alerts on Libre3Plus for up to 6 hours.

text: That's what I ended up doing. I'm just glad that in that time I did not have a real low that needed attention.
